## zh.wikipedia.org (Information)

- https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/最终幻想Artniks -- accessed 2026-10-20 (text pasted by user)
  - Final Fantasy Artniks (ファイナルファンタジーアートニクス), a Japanese social RPG by Square Enix and GREE for mobile phones and GREE, single-series second social game and second co-developed with GREE; director Kazunari Itakura (板倉一成), producer Ichiro Hazama (間一郎); a card game reusing earlier Final Fantasy art, characters and battle systems, with fights against series enemies and bosses and PvP; one million players within the first month; Square Enix's 2013 report called social games like Artniks its most profitable products
  - Date: the infobox says release in Japan on 2013-11-30 while the text says it was released on 2012-11-30 (the entry uses 2012-11-30); candidate in docs/wiki-corrections.md
  - No Japanese Wikipedia page exists for it (checked 2026-10-20 by title; the English and Chinese pages link only each other)

## thefinalfantasy.net (Information; fan site)

- https://thefinalfantasy.net/final-fantasy-artniks/ -- accessed 2026-10-20 (text pasted by user; found during the thefinalfantasy.net audit)
  - A social RPG released only in Japan on 2012-11-30 under GREE on mobile phones, a card game using assets from the whole franchise (characters, battle systems, locations), with battles against enemies or other players for rewards and rankings; over one million players in a month
  - Release table: Mobile Phone (GREE), 2012-11-30 (JP), none for the US; details: developer and publisher Square Enix, director Kazunari Itakura, producer Ichiro Hazama; community rating 2.46 of 5 (13 votes, not used)
  - It says the original and the planned sequel "Final Fantasy Artniks Drive" were both axed for undisclosed reasons and the game is no longer available; the sequel's real name is Artniks Dive and it did launch (2014-11-10; see its entry), a slip candidate in docs/wiki-corrections.md
  - Its 2012-11-30 date agrees with our entry and the text of the zh.wikipedia page (see above)

## Decisions
- GREE is the link for the Android and iOS rows (user, 2026-10-20): the search for direct Play Store and App Store pages is closed, since the game was only available through registration on the GREE website; the rows link the GREE apps page capture of 2013-12-19 and no store page is expected to exist
- No `by` line (user, 2026-10-20): director Kazunari Itakura and producer Ichiro Hazama are named by zh.wikipedia and thefinalfantasy.net, but the entry carries no credits
